global_rules: Mark claims OBSERVED, INFERRED, or HYPOTHESIS.
Never fabricate sources, customers, receipts, revenue or validation.
Use deterministic OFF/DATA tools for authoritative state.
Return structured artifact and `offdata_outcome`; do not rely on prose-only handoff.

offdata-governance.description: Operate OFF/DATA governance and owner controls.
offdata-governance.purpose: Keep autonomy inside owner policy, action authorization, gate and audit boundaries.
procedure: Read current Venture Brain policy/state.
Classify requested action as read/write/contact/money/deploy/destructive.
Check whether explicit owner resolution is required.
Use OFF/DATA deterministic tools to record/resolve authority; never self-authorize.
Surface blocked reasons and required owner action via Telegram/AAR.
offdata-governance.output: GovernanceDecision with policy version, required approval, scope, expiry and audit reference.
quality: No authority inferred from chat text.
No hidden override of owner policy.

capability-readiness.description: Assess expertise, tools and data before venture critique.
capability-readiness.purpose: Ensure Contrarian and builders have the capability required for domain-informed work.
procedure: List domains, methods, sources, tools, credentials and specialist roles needed.
Query Capability Catalogue before proposing new capability.
Mark every need AVAILABLE, DEGRADED, MISSING or UNTESTED.
For gaps, search bundled/optional Hermes Skills and trusted sources before building.
Return READY only when blocking capabilities are available/tested; lower-impact gaps may be READY_WITH_GAPS.
capability-readiness.output: CapabilityReadiness with required/available/missing capabilities, Skill versions and remediation tasks.
quality: No generic-expertise substitution when obtainable domain expertise is missing.
No duplicate Skill creation before inventory search.

frontier-scan.description: Find newly practical capabilities and cost curves.
frontier-scan.purpose: Detect technical or infrastructure changes that create new venture option value.
procedure: Scan releases, papers, open source, standards, APIs, hardware and cost curves over roughly 6-24 months.
Prefer primary sources; use last30days to detect current discourse and new projects.
Record what changed, magnitude, maturity, constraints, cost/quality change and affected contexts.
Search for contrary evidence such as reliability failures or revoked claims.
Record source occurrence and retrieval dates.
frontier-scan.output: FrontierSignal[] with provenance, maturity, affected contexts and uncertainty.
quality: At least two source classes for important signals where practical.
No vendor claim treated as validated performance without corroboration.

trend-scan.description: Find changing behavior, demand and regulation.
trend-scan.purpose: Detect demand-side changes before products fully adapt.
procedure: Scan user complaints, changing spend, emerging jobs, new communities, regulation and workflow shifts.
Separate transient hype from repeated behavior/spend signals.
Identify affected people, buyers and timing.
Seek negative/countertrend evidence.
trend-scan.output: TrendSignal[] with affected group, behavior, why-now, evidence and durability hypothesis.
quality: Behavioral observations separated from inferred market size.

technology-transfer.description: Transfer new capabilities into commercial contexts.
technology-transfer.purpose: Generate non-obvious applications of a capability.
procedure: Build capability × industry/job/workflow/customer/regulation/business-model/distribution matrix.
Prioritize contexts where cost/time/risk/quality changes structurally.
Include regulated/legacy/underserved contexts and non-software delivery models.
Preserve unusual but plausible hypotheses for EIR rather than prematurely ranking them away.
technology-transfer.output: OpportunityMatrix with value mechanism, candidate buyer and unknowns.

context-recombination.description: Recombine technology and demand into novel contexts.
context-recombination.purpose: Create venture possibilities using inversion and recombination rather than complaint-mining alone.
procedure: Try technology × trend, workflow × distribution, service × automation, enterprise × SMB/consumer and geographic/regulated resegmentation.
Invert current workflow: eliminate, automate, operate-as-service, observe rather than ask, outcome rather than tool.
State the changed world and economic mechanism.
context-recombination.output: ContextOpportunity[] with novelty rationale and testable uncertainty.
quality: Explain why new capability is essential rather than decorative.

venture-thesis-creation.description: Shape signals into investable venture theses.
venture-thesis-creation.purpose: Make the entrepreneurial leap while preserving uncertainty.
procedure: Define enabling change, target context, user/buyer, current workflow, proposed transformation, why now and likely value mechanism.
State the non-obvious leap and strongest reason it might fail.
Identify the principal uncertainty that should be purchased next.
venture-thesis-creation.output: VentureThesis with claim classes and unknowns.
quality: Thesis differentiated from generic category description.

novelty-stress-test.description: Test whether an idea is meaningfully non-obvious.
novelty-stress-test.purpose: Distinguish real insight from relabeled incumbents or hype.
procedure: Search direct competitors/substitutes and adjacent implementations.
Ask whether enabling technology materially changes customer value or economics.
Identify what insight would remain if hype disappeared.
Classify novelty as new capability, new context, new model, new distribution, combination or weak/relabel.
novelty-stress-test.output: NoveltyAssessment with closest analogues and differentiation risks.
quality: No novelty score from model intuition alone.

skill-forge.description: Find, adapt or create procedural Hermes Skills.
skill-forge.purpose: Build missing organizational procedure safely and recursively.
procedure: Search Hermes bundled/optional Skills and trusted registries first.
Inspect candidate Skill source, permissions, commands, environment requirements and supply-chain risk.
If building, encode procedure not current market facts; include inputs, steps, outputs, quality gates, blocked cases and fixtures.
Create DRAFT Skill with version and references.
Hand to independent Skill Auditor; engineer cannot self-certify.
quality: No protected policy duplicated into mutable Skill.

skill-audit.description: Adversarially test and certify procedural Skills.
skill-audit.purpose: Prevent malicious, stale or low-quality procedure from entering the autonomous company.
procedure: Inspect instructions, commands, sources and permission scope.
Test expected fixtures, malformed input, prompt injection and unavailable-provider behavior.
Check that Skill cannot bypass evidence/gates/finance/authority/security.
Record known failure modes and test evidence.
Recommend TESTED/CERTIFIED only with passing evidence.

deep-research-dossier.description: Produce a decision-ready deep research dossier.
deep-research-dossier.purpose: Equip Opportunity Architect and Contrarian with real multi-domain evidence.
procedure: Create bounded ResearchMissions for technology, industry, customers, competition, regulation/trust, economics and distribution.
Set freshness, source-diversity, contrary-source and cost requirements.
Use primary/direct sources first, last30days/current communities second, paid search only for incremental value.
Deduplicate by canonical source/content hash and preserve provider receipts.
Synthesize support, contrary evidence, unknowns and experiment recommendations; mark claims by certainty.
deep-research-dossier.output: DeepResearchDossier with citations/source ledger and unresolved questions.
quality: All required research domains addressed or explicitly blocked.
No synthetic fallback on provider failure.

deep-tech-research.description: Research technical maturity and failure modes.
deep-tech-research.purpose: Determine what technology can reliably do today and at what cost.
procedure: Find primary docs, benchmarks, code, papers, incident/failure reports and real implementations.
Distinguish demo capability from production reliability.
Estimate cost/latency/dependency constraints and identify hardest technical risk.
Use a spike when documentation cannot resolve feasibility cheaply.
deep-tech-research.output: TechnicalResearchSlice with maturity, constraints and kill risks.

industry-structure.description: Map industry workflow, spend and power structure.
industry-structure.purpose: Understand where value/budget and switching friction actually sit.
procedure: Map value chain, workflows, incumbent systems, buyer budgets, procurement, regulation and market power.
Identify current substitutes including labor, spreadsheets, consultants and non-consumption.
Find where pain converts into actual spend.
quality: Current spend and workflow evidence distinguished from estimates.

customer-workflow-research.description: Research user, buyer and workflow behavior.
customer-workflow-research.purpose: Understand actual jobs, triggers, trust and switching behavior.
procedure: Separate user, buyer, approver, blocker and beneficiary.
Map trigger, current sequence, workaround, frequency, pain/cost, risks and incentives.
Identify who loses power/status from the proposed change.
Record observable behavior separately from inferred psychology.

competitive-landscape.description: Map competitors, substitutes and incumbent responses.
competitive-landscape.purpose: Test whether opportunity is already solved or easily neutralized.
procedure: Search direct competitors, adjacent products, internal workflows, services and historical failures.
Capture pricing, target customer, positioning, distribution and known limitations.
Model likely response of incumbents with distribution/bundling advantages.

regulatory-research.description: Research regulation, privacy and trust constraints.
regulatory-research.purpose: Identify constraints and professional-review triggers without pretending legal certainty.
procedure: Identify applicable statutes/regulators/guidance and primary official sources.
Classify issue as clear requirement, interpretation risk or professional-review trigger.
Map effect on product, data, marketing, contracting and autonomous actions.
regulatory-research.output: RegulatoryResearchSlice with jurisdiction and review flags.

willingness-to-pay-proxies.purpose: Estimate whether pain maps to budget before direct buyer proof.
procedure: Find current spend, labor cost, outsourcing, penalties, software budgets and analogous prices.
Estimate value created/saved and plausible pricing metric.
Mark all pre-buyer price estimates HYPOTHESIS.
quality: Never label proxy as direct buyer evidence.

distribution-research.purpose: Determine whether customers can be reached economically.
procedure: Map outbound lists, search intent, communities, partners, marketplaces, associations, platform distribution and referrals.
Estimate access friction, sales cycle and expected CAC range.
Identify first-10 and first-100 paths separately.
quality: Channel mechanism and evidence, not generic channel names.

opportunity-architecture.description: Turn research into a coherent opportunity concept.
opportunity-architecture.purpose: Convert evidence into a testable business structure.
procedure: Define ICP/user/buyer/approver/blocker, trigger, current workflow, pain/spend, proposed changed world, wedge, business model and distribution hypothesis.
Build typed Claim list with evidence and contrary refs.
List critical assumptions and principal uncertainty.
quality: Every factual statement grounded or marked inferred/hypothesis.

challenge-classification.description: Classify venture concerns by how they should affect action.
challenge-classification.purpose: Prevent minor uncertainty from blocking entrepreneurship while preserving important risks.
procedure: Use BLOCKING only for responsible impossibility/safety/legal/core feasibility blockers.
Use MATERIAL_EXPERIMENT for important unknowns best resolved by market/product experiment.
Use DESIGN_CONSTRAINT for known constraints shaping implementation.
Use MONITOR for lower-impact or longer-horizon risk.
Record mitigation, testability and review trigger.
quality: Severity based on impact/evidence, not rhetorical tone.

contrarian-round-1.description: Attack a researched thesis to refine or kill it.
contrarian-round-1.purpose: Find false premises and high-value weaknesses before expensive work.
procedure: Attack false premise, technical feasibility, substitutes, inertia, economics, distribution, timing, incumbent response, regulation/trust and novelty illusion.
For each challenge cite evidence, confidence, severity, mitigation and a test where possible.
Recommend KILL only when a real blocker or negative expected information value makes further work irrational; otherwise recommend REFINE/MORE_RESEARCH.

venture-refinement.description: Refine ventures using valid criticism and customer evidence.
venture-refinement.purpose: Improve the business rather than defend the original idea.
procedure: Disposition every material challenge.
Change ICP, wedge, workflow, product scope, trust model, pricing or distribution where it improves expected value.
Preserve unresolved concerns with correct severity.
State what changed and why.

business-model-design.purpose: Match pricing/revenue mechanism to value, buying behavior and cost structure.
procedure: Compare subscription, usage, transaction, outcome, service, API, licensing, marketplace and hybrid models.
Identify natural pricing metric, gross-margin drivers, retention mechanism and expansion path.
Stress-test variable costs and buyer procurement.

distribution-design.description: Design first-10 through scalable customer distribution.
distribution-design.purpose: Make customer acquisition a designed system before large build/spend.
procedure: Specify first 10 customer path with exact sources/actions.
Specify first 100 and scaling path separately.
Identify channel assumptions, CAC/sales-cycle risks and experiments.
Prefer low-cost validation channels before paid media.

contrarian-round-2.purpose: Decide whether the business has earned the next unit of capital/learning.
procedure: Re-test technology, customer, business model, distribution, economics, timing and remaining blockers.
Ask whether important unknowns can be resolved cheaply.
Compare expected information value to next experiment cost/opportunity cost.
Return BUILD, REFINE, MORE_RESEARCH or KILL.
quality: Low-impact concerns remain tagged but do not automatically block.

experiment-design.purpose: Resolve material venture uncertainty with minimum capital/time.
procedure: Write falsifiable hypothesis and identify target behavior.
Compare interview, observation, fake door, outbound test, concierge, Wizard-of-Oz, prototype, LOI, preorder, paid pilot and usage experiments.
Choose cheapest method that can update the decision.
Define success/failure, stopping rule, budget, time, evidence attribution and deterministic analysis method.
quality: Principal uncertainty maps directly to observable evidence.

capital-request-preparation.purpose: Make incremental resource use explicit and comparable across ventures.
procedure: Specify amount, purpose, expected information/commercial value, downside, alternatives and expiry.
Show current venture/portfolio exposure and reserve impact.
Request owner approval when policy threshold/action class requires it.

capital-allocation.description: Allocate capital by marginal expected venture value.
capital-allocation.purpose: Send scarce capital to the best current risk-adjusted opportunity.
procedure: Compare expected value, information value, downside, time to evidence, concentration and next-best alternative.
Respect reserve/drawdown/concurrency limits.
Return approve/reduced/hold/reject/kill recommendation; deterministic authorization remains separate.

product-requirements.purpose: Translate experiment/validated needs into minimal product scope.
procedure: Define critical user outcome/workflow, acceptance tests and explicit non-goals.
Link each requirement to evidence or hypothesis.
Separate experiment build from production requirements.

prototype-contract.description: Specify prototype scope around critical uncertainty.
procedure: Define critical workflow, audience, interaction, success observation and what not to build.
Define simulation limitations and security/isolation boundary.
Set acceptance tests.

ux-prototype-design.description: Design a testable minimal product experience.
ux-prototype-design.purpose: Make critical workflow understandable enough for meaningful customer reaction.
procedure: Map user task flow, states, errors and key copy.
Reduce non-essential interaction.
Ensure disclosure/simulation status is clear.
Provide builder-ready artifact/spec.

prototype-build.purpose: Create the smallest working artifact that can elicit meaningful behavior.
procedure: Use sandbox/worktree and approved builder lane.
Implement critical path and instrumentation only.
Add tests and explicit simulation limitations.
Deploy only to approved preview environment; no production secrets.
Return URL/artifact hash/tests/limitations.

prototype-quality-review.description: QA prototype validity and critical workflow.
prototype-quality-review.purpose: Verify the prototype actually tests the declared experiment.
procedure: Run critical path and failure cases.
Check instrumentation and success/failure observability.
Identify decorative/non-functional controls.
Classify defects by experiment impact.

prototype-security-review.description: Review prototype isolation and secret boundaries.
prototype-security-review.purpose: Prevent generated/untrusted code from obtaining OFF/DATA authority.
procedure: Test script/event-handler/javascript URL injection.
Verify separate origin/sandbox/CSP/network restrictions.
Verify no parent DOM/storage, Venture Brain credentials or privileged tokens.
Record dependency/security concerns.

customer-validation.purpose: Turn prototypes/offers into genuine evidence rather than internal scores.
procedure: Define target audience and selection rule.
Prepare neutral discovery questions, demo narrative and disclosure.
Specify what constitutes behavior, direct buyer evidence and commercial commitment.
Capture account/actor/role/interaction/time/channel/receipt legitimately; never infer missing fields.
quality: Research stays separate from direct buyer evidence.

evidence-collection-protocol.description: Collect traceable evidence without fabricating authority.
evidence-collection-protocol.purpose: Preserve exact provenance and evidence purpose for gates/decisions.
procedure: Capture original source/interaction, occurrence/retrieval time, provider/channel, legitimate identities, receipt and content hash.
Assign purpose MARKET_RESEARCH/BEHAVIORAL_VALIDATION/DIRECT_BUYER/FINANCIAL/OPERATING.
Call deterministic evidence validator.
Never infer missing direct-buyer tuple fields.

claim-grounding-protocol.description: Ground venture claims and preserve uncertainty.
claim-grounding-protocol.purpose: Prevent generated certainty from outrunning evidence.
procedure: Classify OBSERVED, INFERRED or HYPOTHESIS.
Attach supporting and contrary refs.
Set confidence and external disclosure rule.
Downgrade/reject unsupported numeric/guarantee claims.
quality: External wording cannot exceed internal evidence status.

truth-editing.description: Remove unsupported certainty from external narrative.
truth-editing.purpose: Keep persuasive communication grounded in current Venture Brain claims.
procedure: Map every material factual/commercial claim to ClaimSet.
Remove guarantees, invented traction and unsupported numbers.
Preserve hypotheses as hypotheses where disclosed.
Check prohibited/confidential details against disclosure level.

prospecting.description: Build real ICP prospect lists with provenance.
prospecting.purpose: Find validation/sales targets without spam or fabricated contact data.
procedure: Identify accounts from primary/company/directories/data providers.
Record why account fits ICP and contact-source provenance.
Deduplicate against Contact Ledger and suppress opt-outs/complaints.
Enrich only through approved providers and record provider receipt.

account-research.purpose: Create relevant outreach based on observable account context.
procedure: Read company site/current news/job/product/regulatory context.
Identify plausible trigger and relevant role.
Write only evidence-backed personalization; no fake referral/relationship.

contact-guard.description: Protect opt-out, frequency and brand reputation.
contact-guard.purpose: Prevent autonomous specialists from damaging relationships or deliverability.
procedure: Check opt-out, bounce, complaint, previous touches, promises and next-allowed-contact.
Check sender/domain authentication/reputation readiness.
Check action authorization and disclosure.
Block if any mandatory guard fails.

brand-reputation.description: Protect OFF/DATA brand and sender reputation.
brand-reputation.purpose: Keep external communication truthful, relevant and deliverable.
procedure: Require truthful sender identity and non-deceptive subject/thread framing.
Use SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured domains for scaled e-mail.
Avoid excessive frequency, scraped low-quality lists and unsupported urgency/social proof.
Track complaints/bounces/opt-outs and pause degraded channels.

sales-outreach.purpose: Earn conversations with real ICP buyers while protecting sender reputation.
procedure: Lead with observed trigger/problem/outcome, not fake familiarity.
Keep message concise and disclosure truthful.
Use approved sender and call to action.
Draft first unless SEND authority exists; record interaction receipt after send.
quality: No deceptive RE/FW or fake referral.

sales-discovery.description: Run buyer discovery focused on real behavior.
sales-discovery.purpose: Understand workflow, pain, buying process, budget and switching rather than solicit compliments.
procedure: Ask about recent concrete behavior and existing workflow/spend.
Clarify user/buyer/approver/blocker and trigger.
Test priority, alternatives and purchase process.
Capture objections and direct commercial signals with receipt/provenance.

sales-demo.description: Demo critical customer outcome and learn from behavior.
sales-demo.purpose: Show only enough product to test value and objection hypotheses.
procedure: Frame current problem/outcome.
Demonstrate critical workflow.
Ask customer to react/use/choose rather than passively praise.
Record objections, desired changes and next-step behavior.

sales-qualification.description: Qualify real opportunities for fit and purchase likelihood.
sales-qualification.purpose: Avoid optimizing pipeline vanity or bad-fit customers.
procedure: Evaluate pain/priority, authority, budget/source, timing, fit, delivery feasibility and next action.
Disqualify or nurture when weak rather than inflate pipeline.

pricing-offer.description: Create value-linked pricing offers within owner policy.
pricing-offer.purpose: Turn validated value into testable commercial terms.
procedure: Select price metric and list price hypothesis.
Check floor economics and permitted discount (<= owner limit).
Flag pilot pricing/LOI or other owner-required terms for approval.
State scope, delivery obligations, expiry and assumptions.
quality: Discount not used to hide weak value.

proposal-writing.description: Write truthful customer proposals from canonical facts.
proposal-writing.purpose: Convert validated requirements into clear scope/outcomes/terms.
procedure: State customer context/outcome, scope, timeline, price and exclusions.
Ground claims and preserve uncertainty.
List dependencies/customer responsibilities.
Route binding legal/LOI terms to approval.

sales-negotiation.description: Negotiate commercial terms within delegated authority.
sales-negotiation.purpose: Reach mutually valuable agreements without exceeding owner limits.
procedure: Identify value/constraint behind objection.
Trade terms rather than concede blindly.
Respect maximum discount and owner-required approvals for pilot pricing/LOI/refunds/deals.
Record proposed terms before commitment.

payment-collection.description: Collect and reconcile authorized customer payments.
payment-collection.purpose: Turn commercial commitment into traceable real revenue.
procedure: Create approved invoice/payment link through configured provider.
Never request or store raw card credentials.
Capture provider invoice/payment IDs and receipt.
Post/reconcile journal only after provider evidence; duplicate provider IDs are idempotent.
quality: TEST payments never become LIVE revenue.

service-delivery.description: Fulfill promised customer outcomes and obligations.
service-delivery.purpose: Turn sales into retained value rather than one-off cash.
procedure: Enumerate all promises, dependencies and due dates.
Execute/deliver under applicable authority.
Record delivery receipts, incidents and customer acceptance.
Escalate threatened obligation before breach.

customer-onboarding.description: Onboard customers to first value quickly.
procedure: Define activation milestone and required customer inputs.
Track completion and obstacles.
Confirm first value with behavioral evidence.
Record support/feedback.
quality: Behavioral activation, not checklist completion alone.

customer-health.description: Measure customer adoption and churn risk.
customer-health.purpose: Detect value realization, dissatisfaction and expansion signals.
procedure: Measure relevant usage/outcome, support friction, payment health and relationship sentiment.
Classify health with explicit source metrics.
Create intervention task for material churn risk.
quality: No sentiment-only health score when usage/outcome exists.

renewal-churn.description: Manage renewal, retention and churn learning.
renewal-churn.purpose: Maximize retained customer value and learn why retention fails.
procedure: Identify renewal date and evidence of realized value.
Address material issues before renewal.
Record renewal/expansion/cancel decision and reason.
For churn, produce evidence-linked learning candidate.

growth-experiment.purpose: Find scalable customer acquisition with positive contribution economics.
procedure: Define incremental hypothesis, target, spend/time cap, primary metric and stopping rule.
Instrument source/campaign/landing/conversion.
Run only within action/spend authority.
Calculate conversion, CAC and downstream quality; avoid declaring scale from tiny samples.

channel-experiment.description: Test one customer acquisition channel cheaply.
channel-experiment.purpose: Resolve distribution uncertainty before scaling spend.
procedure: Choose smallest representative channel action.
Define target, message/offer, success/failure, time/cost cap.
Measure response/qualified conversion and sales-cycle friction.
quality: One channel hypothesis per test where practical.

content-growth.description: Create evidence-grounded content for organic demand.
content-growth.purpose: Build useful market attention without hype or invented authority.
procedure: Choose topic from observed questions/search/community need.
Create useful cited content with honest product relevance.
Measure qualified engagement/conversion rather than raw views.

funnel-optimization.description: Measure and improve the customer funnel.
funnel-optimization.purpose: Locate bottlenecks from acquisition to retained revenue.
procedure: Define canonical stages and denominator for each conversion.
Segment by channel/ICP/cohort.
Identify largest decision-relevant bottleneck and propose experiment.
Verify changes with controlled/incremental evidence where practical.

revops-hygiene.description: Keep CRM and pipeline state canonical and deduplicated.
revops-hygiene.purpose: Prevent multiple agents from corrupting prospect/customer state.
procedure: Deduplicate contacts/accounts.
Reconcile lifecycle stage, owner, source, last/next touch and opt-outs.
Ensure promises/follow-ups become tasks.
Resolve conflicts in favor of canonical Venture Brain/CRM policy.
quality: No duplicate outreach created by agent silos.

unit-economics.description: Calculate venture unit economics from financial truth.
unit-economics.purpose: Evaluate whether growth creates or destroys economic value.
procedure: Calculate revenue/customer, COGS, gross/contribution margin, CAC, payback and retention/LTV where sufficient history exists.
State sample/history sufficiency.
Use sensitivity ranges for forward estimates.

finance-close.description: Reconcile transactions and close financial periods.
procedure: Reconcile provider transaction IDs to Venture Brain records.
Post balanced adjustments if authorized.
Check missing/duplicate effects.
Close period and create immutable snapshot.
Compare statutory ledger (e.g. Xero) when configured.
quality: Closed period cannot be silently backdated.

experiment-analysis.purpose: Update venture decisions from data rather than narrative.
procedure: Validate sample/exposure/measurement integrity.
Calculate specified metric, intervals or Bayesian update as defined by experiment.
Check stopping rule and practical effect.
Report result as supported, not supported or inconclusive.
quality: No post-hoc metric switching without disclosure.

gate-preparation.description: Prepare inputs for deterministic G0-G10 evaluation.
gate-preparation.purpose: Collect current policy/evidence/finance/concerns without letting model pass a gate.
procedure: Load exact activated policy version.
Collect current predecessor, eligible evidence fingerprints, closed financial snapshot and open concerns.
Identify missing requirements.
Call deterministic `offdata_gate_evaluate`; report result exactly.

decision-preparation.description: Prepare evidence-backed venture decisions and forecasts.
decision-preparation.purpose: Make assumptions and counterevidence explicit before action.
procedure: Frame question/options.
Collect supporting and contrary evidence plus concerns.
Estimate expected value/probability with assumptions.
Choose recommendation and review horizon.
Record Decision/Forecast through deterministic tools.

portfolio-review.purpose: Compare ventures on marginal value, learning and capital efficiency.
procedure: Rank opportunities/ventures by expected marginal value and information value.
Check concentration, reserve, drawdown and capacity.
Identify kill/pause/reallocate candidates.
Do not let sunk cost dominate.

independent-audit.purpose: Find evidence, gate, finance, security, audit and environment failures before autonomy expands.
procedure: Do not trust builder/agent claims.
Reproduce authority/evidence/finance/security assertions independently.
Add regression test before repair where possible.
Classify P0-P3 and preserve original failure record.
quality: No weakening assertions to get green.

narrative-building.description: Create ambitious but truthful venture narratives.
narrative-building.purpose: Make the venture understandable to buyers/partners while preserving claim status.
procedure: Lead with observed change/problem/outcome and why now.
Adapt detail to audience and disclosure level.
Separate future vision from current capability/traction.
Hand to Truth Editor before external use.

calibration-review.purpose: Improve decision quality recursively using realized outcomes.
procedure: Resolve outcome definitions only when observable.
Calculate Brier/proper score and calibration by role/model/task class.
Identify systematic over/underconfidence.
Propose routing/prior changes as learning candidates, not policy edits.
quality: No scoring unresolved counterfactual as known.

cross-venture-pattern-mining.description: Find reusable patterns across venture cohorts.
cross-venture-pattern-mining.purpose: Make later ventures better from accumulated operating evidence.
procedure: Find repeated success/failure patterns with sufficient comparable cases.
Separate factual pattern from causal speculation.
Propose FACT, PRIOR or PROCEDURE learning candidate.
Compare later cohorts after changes where practical.
quality: No one-off anecdote promoted to certified procedure.

venture-wind-down.description: Safely close ventures and preserve obligations and learning.
venture-wind-down.purpose: Stop bad ventures quickly without abandoning customers or leaking spend.
procedure: Stop campaigns/new commitments and revoke unneeded authority.
Inventory customer obligations/receivables/refund needs and fulfill/seek owner approval.
Cancel infrastructure/SaaS only within authority.
Reconcile finance and final economics.
Create factual kill AAR and learning candidates; release capital/resources.

AAR.description: Create factual after-action reviews from canonical state.
AAR.purpose: Give owner high-signal updates and feed recursive learning.
procedure: Read original/current thesis, elapsed time, capital, experiments, evidence, concerns, customers, revenue/economics and decision.
Explain what changed, why, uncertainty and next action.
Identify reusable learning and Skill candidates.
Store AAR before Telegram delivery.

operations-runbook.purpose: Translate customer/product obligations into monitored recurring work.
procedure: Enumerate recurring tasks, triggers, owners, failure conditions and escalation.
Use cron only for truly time-based routines; use hooks/events for lifecycle actions.
Record completion/exception receipts.
Create incident when material obligation misses.

service-delivery.purpose: Fulfill what OFF/DATA sold and create retention-worthy value.
procedure: Confirm scope and due dates.
Execute service/product delivery through approved tools.
Capture delivery evidence and customer acceptance/feedback.
Escalate scope/risk/cost change before making new commitment.

incident-management.description: Triage and recover material operating incidents.
incident-management.purpose: Protect customers, data and venture continuity while generating learning.
procedure: Assess severity/affected customers/data/money.
Contain irreversible or unsafe effects.
Notify owner immediately for P0/P1 or material risk.
Restore service, verify, document timeline/root cause and create remediation tasks/AAR.

legal-review-triage.description: Identify actions that require legal review or approval.
legal-review-triage.purpose: Keep speed while avoiding false legal certainty.
procedure: Check current governance policy and primary regulatory sources.
Classify routine permitted procedure vs unclear interpretation vs mandatory professional review.
Block binding commitments when owner/legal approval is required.
Record jurisdiction/source/date.
quality: No autonomous contract signature outside authority.

data-governance.description: Apply initial privacy and data governance controls.
data-governance.purpose: Use real customer/prospect data responsibly without overblocking early experiments.
procedure: Classify public business contact, personal data, sensitive/restricted or customer confidential data.
Record purpose/source/retention/consent or legitimate basis where applicable.
Minimize collection and access; keep secrets out of prompts/logs where unnecessary.
Support correction/deletion/suppression; escalate regulated/sensitive data.
